mapper.select: SELECT ss.id, ssv.id AS versionId, ss.name, ss.code, ssv.version_no AS versionNo FROM lm_stability_scheme ss INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON ssv.scheme_id = ss.id AND ssv.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ss.is_deleted = 0 AND ss.material_id = #{materialId} AND ssv.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE') ORDER BY ss.name, ssv.version_no DESC

SELECT DISTINCT tpTask.experiment_type AS experimentType, tpTask.storage_condition AS storageCondition FROM lm_stability_plan_timepoint_task tpTask INNER JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON tpTask.inspection_order_id = io.id AND io.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON io.scheme_version_id = ssv.id AND ssv.is_deleted = 0 WHERE tpTask.is_deleted = 0 AND ssv.id = #{versionId} ORDER BY tpTask.experiment_type, tpTask.storage_condition

SELECT DISTINCT ip.id, ip.code, ip.name FROM lm_stability_scheme_data_point ssdp INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON ssdp.version_id = ssv.id AND ssv.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON ssdp.parameter_id = ip.id AND ip.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ssdp.is_deleted = 0 AND ssv.id = #{versionId} ORDER BY ip.code

SELECT DISTINCT ssdp.id, ssdp.name FROM lm_stability_scheme_data_point ssdp INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON ssdp.version_id = ssv.id AND ssv.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ssdp.is_deleted = 0 AND ssv.id = #{versionId} AND ssdp.parameter_id = #{parameterId} AND ssdp.point_type IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ssdp.name

SELECT DISTINCT io.batch_no AS batchNo FROM lm_inspection_order io INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON io.scheme_version_id = ssv.id AND ssv.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_plan_timepoint_task tpTask ON tpTask.inspection_order_id = io.id AND tpTask.is_deleted = 0 WHERE io.is_deleted = 0 AND io.order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND ssv.id = #{versionId} AND tpTask.experiment_type = #{experimentType} AND tpTask.storage_condition = #{storageCondition} ORDER BY io.batch_no

SELECT ssdp.id AS dataPointId, ssdp.name AS dataPointName, ssdp.point_type AS pointType, ip.name AS parameterName, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec FROM lm_stability_scheme_data_point ssdp INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON ssdp.version_id = ssv.id AND ssv.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme ss ON ssv.scheme_id = ss.id AND ss.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON ss.material_id = m.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON ssdp.parameter_id = ip.id AND ip.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ssdp.is_deleted = 0 AND ssv.id = #{versionId} AND ssdp.name = #{dataPointName} LIMIT 1

SELECT #{batchNo} AS batchNo, 0 AS timeValue, 'MONTH' AS timeUnit, ier.value_number AS valueNumber, ier.value_text AS valueText FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier INNER JOIN lm_task t ON ier.task_id = t.id AND t.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON t.inspection_order_id = io.id AND io.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_data_point ssdp ON ier.data_point_config_id = ssdp.id AND ssdp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ier.is_deleted = 0 AND io.id = #{orderId} AND io.order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND ssdp.name = #{dataPointName}

SELECT DISTINCT sspt.time_value AS timeValue, sspt.time_unit AS timeUnit FROM lm_stability_scheme_plan_timepoint sspt INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_plan ssp ON sspt.plan_id = ssp.id AND ssp.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON ssp.version_id = ssv.id AND ssv.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sspt.is_deleted = 0 AND ssv.id = #{versionId} AND ssp.experiment_type = #{experimentType} AND ssp.storage_condition = #{storageCondition} ORDER BY sspt.time_value
